exposure: expected fetal weight in the third trimester (ExFW3t)
estimated fetal weight (EFW) at mid-trimester ultrasound scan
percentage difference with actual third-trimester EFW (%ExFW3t)
middle cerebral artery pulsatility index (MCA PI)
cohort: 777 singleton pregnancies that underwent a 20-week ultrasound scan and a third-trimester scan.
finding: Fetal weight-related parameters were less effective than fetal cerebral Doppler for predicting intrapartum fetal compromise, with the best prediction achieved by combining hemodynamic, ponderal, and clinical data.
cross-section timing: Measurements taken at mid-trimester (20 weeks) and third-trimester ultrasound scans.
gest_age: Around 20 weeks and in the third trimester
